world.title: The Known World
world.summary: Across the broken frontier of the Old Kingdom, rival realms, haunted woods, and forgotten shrines shape the fate of the campaign. Some roads are safe, most are not, and every travel-worn path carries a story still waiting to be told.
world.description: The campaign unfolds across a fractured frontier of ancient kingdoms, haunted wilds, and forgotten shrines. The world is full of broken oaths, old magic, and danger that waits just beyond the nearest road.

points.title: The Whispering Forest
points.summary: The party enters the Blackbriar frontier, where a forgotten lantern is said to have warmed the land before the first winter of ruin. Old roots sway like whispers, and every trail seems to remember the names of those who are already lost.
points.description: A moonlit woodland of ash-pale trees and whispering roots where the campaign begins beneath a lantern omen and a broken frontier road.

points.title: Ashes of the Moor
points.summary: A ruined keep rises from a field of smoldering heather, where the cult’s first ash-mark is found beneath a collapsed bell tower. The air tastes of smoke and prophecy.
points.description: A burned moor of cracked stone, collapsing towers, and ash-marked cult sigils.

points.title: The Shattered Tide
points.summary: A drowned chapel and black tide pull the party toward an enemy they cannot name. Strange sea sigils pulse beneath the moon, and the dead follow the sound of bells across the sand.
points.description: A moonlit coast haunted by drowned shrines and a black tide.

points.title: The Iron Ridge
points.summary: The mountains answer with thunder and glacier-cold silence. Within the ruined fortress, a crown of stormsteel is hidden beyond a door that only opens to a vow.
points.description: A thunder-ridden mountain pass where broken fortresses cling to glacier cliffs.

points.title: The Glass Marsh
points.summary: The marsh gleams like broken glass beneath the twilight. The party follows a trail of lantern-light through reeds that whisper in a hundred old dialects, each one naming a forbidden oath.
points.description: A mirrored swamp of translucent water, whispering reeds, and old oaths.

points.title: The Vault of Echoes
points.summary: Beneath the ruins of a collapsed citadel, the party uncovers a chamber of listening stone where every memory is stored in a different bell tone. The cult’s plan becomes more dreadful and more intimate.
points.description: A buried chamber beneath ruined stone where listening bells hold memories.

points.title: The Hollow Crown
points.summary: A dead throne room opens beneath a frozen shrine, revealing the final living remnant of a kingdom that chose ritual over mercy. The party gains the choice to either break or wear the crown’s burden.
points.description: A frozen shrine and throne room at the edge of the world.

points.title: First Dawn
points.summary: At the peak of the world, the signal of the first dawn waits under a temple of stars. The final cost of the ritual is no longer hidden; it is carried in the hands of the heroes who chose to stand against it.
points.description: The highest observatory in the world, where a star-temple waits above the clouds.
